title.en: MALACANAN PALACE BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES OF STRENGTHENING THE FUNCTIONAL ARRANGEMENTS IN THE OFFICE OF THE PRESIDENT

text.en:
Public Concerns Office. The PCO is hereby transferred back to
the control and supervision of the PMS. PCO shall continue to institute feedback
mechanisms for requests for assistance, complaints and grievances received by offices
under the Office of the President and referred to other concerned government agencies
or instrumentalities.
The PCO shall also provide feedback to the Scecial Assistant to the President on
actions taken by agencies as regards requests for assistance, complaints and
grievances referred to them.

Cabinet Staff Support. In accordance with EO No. 1 (s. 2016), the
PMS shall continue to support the Cabinet Secretary in his role as Secretary to the
Cabinet through the provision of substantive and logistical support, including the: a)
THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES

development of the Cabinet Agenda; b) documentation of the meetings of the Cabinet
and the Cabinet Assistance System; and c) crafting of the Cabinet Directives, as well as
monitoring and follow through of these directives.
Both the CSO and DMO shall remain under PMS, which shall exercise direct
control and supervision over these offices. The PMS and OCS shall strengthen their
functional arrangements by way of close coordination and information-sharing.

Separability Clause. If any section or part of this Order is held
unconstitutional or invalid, the other sections or provisions not otherwise affected
shall remain in full force or effect.

Repealing Clause. All provisions of EO No. 9 (s. 2016) inconsistent
with this Order are hereby amended accordingly.

Effectivity. This Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE, in the City of Manila, this 15thday of September in the year of our
Lord, Two Thousand and Seventeen.
,
By the President:
SALVADOR C. MEDIALDEA
Executive Secretary
REPUBLIC OF THE PHILIPPIKES
